Title: (LSJ) Games of Instinct, Psyche, and Telepathic Tracking

Messages.Author: John Zbyszinski
Messages.Body:
If someone used GoI to enter combat and the opposing minion ends
combat what happens when you play Psyche or TT?

I would believe that the Psyche would not give you the benefit of the
GoI, but the TT would.

Thanks,
John Z.

Messages.Author: Colin McGuigan
Messages.Body:
John Zbyszinski wrote:



You would be correct.

"(D) Enter combat with an older vampire controlled by another
Methuselah. At the end of _that_ combat, if only one combatant is ready,..."

(Emphasis mine, of course) If you've Psyche!ed, it's no longer _that_
combat.

--Colin McGuigan
